subject.title: improve(diagnostics-otel): make agent-duration histograms usable beyond 10s

question: Which diagnostics-otel bucket policy should be supported before either overlapping histogram-boundary PR lands?
rationale: The code mechanism is supported by OpenTelemetry, but this changes default aggregation for existing exported metrics and overlaps with a broader open policy proposal.

options.title: Choose one policy after proof
options.body: Require the selected branch to include redacted real OTel export proof and retarget or close the overlapping branch before merge.

options.title: Land this narrow scope
options.body: Accept this PR's run/harness duration and context-token bucket advice while leaving other millisecond histograms on SDK defaults.

options.title: Prefer the broader policy
options.body: Use the related pull request's all-millisecond-duration approach if consistent duration buckets across diagnostics-otel is the intended default.

recommendation.title: Choose one policy after proof
recommendation.body: Require the selected branch to include redacted real OTel export proof and retarget or close the overlapping branch before merge.
